metadata.description: Local development marketplace for cccollab. Loads the plugin from ../plugin so changes to plugin.json / .mcp.json / skills are picked up immediately. The MCP command runs the repo's bin/cccollab, which prefers src/ + tsx over dist/ (run `npm link` in the repo once so the binary resolves to local source).
